importance_ranking.reason: Significant visual variation between sub-types — single FRP cabin, MS multi-seat block, combined toilet+bath, trailer-mounted unit. Buyers scan images to confirm product type before reading any text; wrong type is an immediate skip.

Number of seats, wall material, configuration (toilet-only vs toilet+bath), and tank capacity are non-negotiable shortlisting criteria driven by labour camp headcount and site conditions. Listings without these specs cannot be evaluated.

Construction procurement buyers are price-aggressive and compare across sellers after spec match. Price varies substantially with seat count, wall material, and configuration — buyers use listed price as a budget entry gate before contacting sellers.

importance_ranking.brand_important_reason: No dominant brand with buyer recall in this category — market is fragmented across regional FRP and MS fabricators; buyers search by spec and price, not manufacturer name.
importance_ranking.reason: Government/PSU buyers and EPC contractors evaluate manufacturer credentials, bulk supply reliability, and installation/warranty support during vendor selection; post-sale dependency is real but company ranks below spec and price in initial shortlisting.

importance_ranking.unit_note: Multi-seat blocks sold per unit/block; custom MS fabrications occasionally quoted per sq ft — sub-segment ambiguity exists but does not affect the primary single-cabin buyer experience.
importance_ranking.reason: Unit is overwhelmingly implied as per piece for the primary segment (single FRP/MS cabin). No buyer questions whether a portable toilet cabin is sold per piece.
